artifacts: Visual artifacts, such as fish disappearing or swimming into rocks, were distracting for some users.
boring: Future iterations should add more variety to the visuals.
bubbles: Many participants found the rising bubbles calming, though the number of bubbles should not be too plentiful.
color: Few participants commented on color; saturation's effect on stress level appeared to vary by individual.
environment: Many participants found the underwater scene calming, but this may have the opposite effect on others.
isolation: There were mixed opinions on whether the lonely feeling of the Calm scene reduced stressed.
motion: Participants were strongly divided on the appropriate amount of moving elements for reducing stress.
no depth: The lack of stereoscopic 3D hindered immersion.
sound: Many participants believed the ambient underwater sound was calming.
visual quality: Participants noted distorted objects at the edge of the video, and overall blurriness.
void: Content was limited to a relatively small solid angle.
